author: Night Light Arcade
title: Hiring artists for banners and platform icons
content: I want to pay real people to make real art! AI content on my shit bothers me haha I love @_VGen_ so much! let's see who I can hire today. I need original art for my banners and icons for all platforms. Plus, it just feels good to help other humans out. Tomorrow I will narrow down who to go with! TY already have 1 person in mind, need a FEW! testing different art styles. Contact: reply or VGen; they said they would narrow candidates the next day.
